title: How Our Bread Is Made
description: From mixing the dough to the finished loaf, every batch goes through three main stages.

steps.title: Mixing and Kneading
steps.description: Flour, water, yeast and the other ingredients are measured and mixed, then kneaded into a smooth, elastic dough.

image.alt: Spiral dough mixer with a stainless steel bowl in the Royal Retreat Bakery production area

steps.title: Proofing and Shaping
steps.description: The dough rests so the yeast can help it rise. It is then divided, shaped into loaves and left to rise again in their tins.

image.alt: Royal Retreat Bakery kitchen with a stainless steel work table, rolling pins, proofing baskets and trays of baked goods

steps.title: Baking and Packaging
steps.description: The loaves are baked until golden, then cooled and packed so they reach you fresh.

image.alt: Stainless steel deck oven beside cooling racks in the Royal Retreat Bakery
